title: Modrinth Advanced Exclusions Should Be Saved
summary: ### Suggestion The toggle state of each advanced exclusion should be saved and retained when closing or reopening the 'Download Mods' screen ### Benefit Most (if not all) of the advanced exclusions are things people would likely want to always exclude (photosensitivity triggers, AI content, ads, etc). Needing to manually re-enable them each time you search for a mod is tedious and frustrating. ### This suggestion is unique - [x] I have searched the issue tracker and did not find an issue describing my suggestion, especially not one that has been rejected. ### You may use the editor below to elaborate further. The feature was added in #6045 for upcoming version 12.0.0
